content: Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) and Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) are conditions that can occur in individuals with metabolic risk factors such as prediabetes and diabetes. The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends the use of the FIB-4 index as an initial screening tool for these individuals. The FIB-4 index is considered a cost-effective method to identify those who may be at risk for liver disease, allowing for early detection and potential intervention.
